desc: Verify the binomial-congruence proof that \((N+1)^n-1\) is divisible by \(N^2\) iff \(N\mid n\).
Confirm all output bounds for \(A=N+1\) and \(M=N^2\).
Implement input parsing and output for up to \(10^4\) test cases.
Preserve the provided sample outputs while using the general construction for other values.
